hypothesis: Within-date rank targets reduce dominance of extreme realized return magnitudes and improve cross-year selection relative to identical return-target trees; this tests an objective, not a new economic information source.
eligibility: Same price-only ordinary-stock pool for all four methods: 120 complete market closes, raw close>=10, positive volume, trailing20 turnover>=10 million TWD and finite ten price features. No flow/revenue completeness filter; this differs from the old all-feature pool, so refit both objectives on this pool.
training: Expand from2023. First signal may be prior year final market close; every training label endpoint <= previous calendar yearend AND <= first evaluation signal. Exactly same finite-label rows and weights for both objectives. No future result filter in scoring pool.
rank_target: Average tied ascending within-signal-date percentile rank of finite future net-relative endpoints in that date price pool. Unknown endpoints excluded from training targets, retained in evaluation selections. Purge whole date groups before fitting; labels mature on common60th market day.
return_target: Stock adjusted t+1 open to t+60 close after frozen proportional costs minus gross0050 return on same endpoints. Missing interior prices do not erase valid endpoints; missing endpoints remain unknown.
evaluation: Daily top10%, monthlyTop15, ties by symbol; no replacements. Same known dates across all4 methods for direct contrasts; report each excluded date and missing selected counts. IC uses observed labels only, not a prospective pool filter.
primary: rank_tree minus return_tree, daily same-date net-relative endpoint mean

uncertainty.method: Circular blocks on original mature signal-date positions with missing paired differences retained; do not compress missing calendar gaps or shorten blocks; disclose invalid draws and boundaries

continuation_gate.primary: Rank-minus-return positive in all3 evaluated years
continuation_gate.baselines: Rank beats BOTH momentum and volatility on the same date set in at least2 of3 years
continuation_gate.meaning: Descriptive resource gate only; already seen history, not statistical validation or trading qualification

stop: Exactly one parameter setting, six serial fits, all3 years reported. No retuning after results. If gate fails close objective branch; no automatic data acquisition.
limitations: Already researched2024-2026, not a fresh holdout
Price-only pool is a separately declared controlled comparison, not old full-feature model reproduction
Adjusted prices are frozen research proxies; historical publication/version and universe limitations remain
Overlapping60-day windows are not independent trades, annual returns or NAV
Proportional costs omit minimum fees, turnover and actual fills; benchmark gross as frozen
Rank fitting is squared-error regression on percentile labels, not pairwise learning-to-rank; it does not predict calibrated return or probability
